Model organisms are a small group of organisms
chosen for genetic research. Model organisms must
meet all of the following requirements, $\_\_\_\_\_\_$.

questions.text: An individual with a dominant phenotype (E/?) crossed with a recessive tester strain (e/e) resulted in a 1:1 ratio of E/e to e/e progeny. What is the genotype of the E/? individual?

questions.text: A family tree or pedigree can be used to show the inheritance of mutant genes. Which of these  is true regarding a pedigree?
choices: Squares are females and circles are males.
Vertical lines connect a mating pair.
Horizontal lines connect a mating pair to their offspring.
Filled squares or circles indicate an affected individual.
